description:
Configure Android Studio to enforce a standard copyright header for the 'TechCorpApp' project. 

1. Open the project settings and navigate to Editor > Copyright > Copyright Profiles.
2. Create a new Copyright Profile named 'TechCorpLicense'.
3. Use the following exact text for the license:

Copyright (C) 2025 TechCorp Inc.
All rights reserved.

Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.

4. Set this new profile as the Default project copyright profile.
5. Apply the copyright header to the entire project (Update Copyright). Ensure both Kotlin files (e.g., MainActivity.kt) and XML files (e.g., activity_main.xml) receive the header.

Note: The IDE handles comment syntax (// or <!--) automatically; you only need to provide the raw text.

expected_text_parts: Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.
